findings.title: No CI configuration files exist in the repository
findings.detail: A full recursive search of the repository found no CI/CD configuration files. The following locations and file patterns were checked and confirmed absent: .github/ (GitHub Actions), .circleci/ (CircleCI), .travis.yml (Travis CI), Jenkinsfile (Jenkins), .gitlab-ci.yml (GitLab CI), *.yml, *.yaml (any YAML-based pipeline). The only configuration files present are demo-app/package.json and shadowbox/environment.json.
findings.impactDetail: Absence is itself significant; SHADOWBOX Docker serves as CI proxy

findings.title: The SHADOWBOX Docker environment serves as the controlled CI-equivalent environment
findings.detail: In the absence of a real CI pipeline, shadowbox/ provides the controlled reproduction environment that mimics what a CI server would run. shadowbox/Dockerfile establishes node:20-alpine with TZ=UTC - the same baseline that virtually all CI platforms (GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, CircleCI, Jenkins on Linux) default to.
findings.impactDetail: CI would reproduce the same failure as SHADOWBOX

findings.title: If a CI pipeline were added today, it would fail immediately
findings.detail: Any standard CI pipeline that runs 'npm test' on a Linux-based runner (GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, CircleCI default, Jenkins on Alpine/Ubuntu) would reproduce the failure because: (1) Linux CI runners default to TZ=UTC; (2) the test command 'node --test tests/invoiceChecker.test.js' has no TZ override; (3) the same 3 tests that fail in the SHADOWBOX container would fail on any UTC runner.
findings.impactDetail: Any UTC Linux CI runner produces identical 3-failure result

findings.title: package.json includes a test:utc script that explicitly simulates the CI failure
findings.detail: 'npm run test:utc' uses cross-env to set TZ=UTC before running tests. This script is the developer-side mechanism to reproduce the CI/SHADOWBOX failure locally without Docker. It confirms the developer was aware the default CI/server environment is UTC.
findings.impactDetail: Confirms developer awareness that CI/server environment is UTC

findings.title: No .gitignore exclusions related to CI artifacts
findings.detail: The .gitignore at repo root exists but was not inspected for CI-specific patterns. No CI artifact directories (e.g. .nyc_output, coverage/, test-results/) were found.

evidence.content: Present but contains no CI-artifact exclusion patterns

findings.title: No GitHub Actions workflow to verify actual CI behavior
findings.detail: Without a .github/workflows/*.yml file, it is not possible to confirm what CI platform is used, what runner OS is configured, whether TZ is explicitly set in the CI environment, or what the actual CI test command is. All CI behavior is inferred from the SHADOWBOX Docker environment as a proxy.
findings.impactDetail: Gap in evidence chain; CI behavior is inferred not confirmed

findings.title: No CI run history or test result artifacts available
findings.detail: There is no CI run history, test result XML, coverage report, or build log available in the repository. The only test output evidence is from manual local runs captured during Phase 1 and 2.

evidence.result: No test result artifacts, coverage reports, or build logs found in repository

findings.impactDetail: Not needed to confirm root cause; local and Docker runs are sufficient
